scope: Synthetic actual-module tests and isolated PostgreSQL 17.11 transactions; no production or physical-device claims

baseline_reproduction.method: Actual baseline TypeScript modules, development fallback disabled, synthetic storage/transport boundaries; no live database or incident claim.
baseline_reproduction.injected_failure: set write fails after session header upsert succeeds

application_assertions: Local completion acknowledged before cloud response
Restart before sync and after server commit converges
New save during active sync is drained
Generation invalidation survives interrupted physical purge
Stale editors and responses cannot transfer pending workouts
Delayed deletion response does not sign out a newer account
Invalid numeric values reject before completion entry or RPC
Stalled telemetry does not block completion navigation
limitations: Migration not applied to production; App Store binary unchanged
No fsync or device power-loss guarantee
No offline cold-start guarantee with unavailable cached owner
No atomic isolation claim for every legacy global cache
Node filesystem benchmark is not native-device latency
Signing out intentionally removes unsynced device-only work
